physicalNotes: No radius or mass of the Nearby Universe is recorded: it is a scale of the universe seen from inside. Its page is centred on a star, and its package frames the view with a sphere of the nominal solar radius, 695,700 km (IAU 2015 Resolution B3), a presentation value.

sources.position: The observer. The Nearby Universe is what lies within a distance of the Sun, so it has no centre but the Sun: the distance is zero and the direction stands for none.
sources.distance: Zero: it is centred on the observer (see position).
sources.properMotion: Zero: it is centred on the observer.
sources.radialVelocity: Zero: it is centred on the observer.
